chunks: Abu Abdillah عليه السلام said to 'Ammar ibn Musa:
O 'Ammar, I will sum up all forgetfulness for you in two words: whenever you doubt, take the greater number; then when you have given salat (prayer) salām, complete what you thought you had omitted.

key_terms.السَّهْوَ: forgetfulness or inadvertent error in salat (prayer)
key_terms.بِالْأَكْثَرِ: by the greater number in cases of uncertainty
key_terms.سَلَّمْتَ: you concluded the salat (prayer) with salām

ai.seo_question: What should a person do when they doubt the number of rak'ahs in salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a concise juridical principle for handling doubt in salat (prayer). When uncertainty occurs in the number of units, one acts on the greater number, and after concluding the prayer, completes what one thinks may have been missed.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.992 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said to Ammar ibn Musa:

"O’ Ammar, I will sum up all forgetfulness for you in two words: Whenever you are in doubt, follow the majority (the greater number). When you finish your prayer, complete what you thought you may have missed”.
